edits.current: VacacionesComunes and VacacionesCompensadas. They must not be merged: enjoyed vacation is in the contribution base, compensated vacation is not.
edits.proposed: VacacionesComunes and VacacionesCompensadas. They must not be merged. Vacation paid in cash (during employment or on termination) is NOT part of the IBC for health, pension and occupational risk (Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, exp. 26941 of 2024-04-04; unification ruling exp. 25185 of 2021, rule 1), while for enjoyed vacation days health and pension are contributed on the IBC of the month before the vacation starts (DUR 780 de 2016 art. 3.2.5.1; Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, exp. 25958 of 2022). Both enjoyed vacation and vacation paid in cash ARE part of the parafiscal base for CCF, SENA and ICBF (Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17; Ley 89 de 1988 art. 1 par. 1; Consejo de Estado, Sala de Consulta, concept 2027 of 2010).

edits.current: Vacation days paid in cash instead of enjoyed. A SEPARATE element from vacation taken, because compensated vacation is NOT part of the social-security contribution base while enjoyed vacation is - the engine must not merge them.
edits.proposed: Vacation days paid in cash instead of enjoyed (during employment, CST art. 189, or on termination, Ley 995 de 2005 art. 1). A SEPARATE element from vacation taken: vacation paid in cash is NOT part of the health, pension and occupational-risk IBC (Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, exp. 26941 of 2024; unification ruling exp. 25185 of 2021, rule 1), whereas for enjoyed vacation days health and pension are contributed on the IBC of the month before the vacation starts (DUR 780 de 2016 art. 3.2.5.1; Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, exp. 25958 of 2022). Both ARE part of the parafiscal base (CCF and SENA - Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17; ICBF - Ley 89 de 1988 art. 1 par. 1; Consejo de Estado, Sala de Consulta, concept 2027 of 2010). The engine must not merge them.

edits.current:
Money value of the vacation enjoyed. Vacation pay IS part of the contribution base; note that vacation is paid on ordinary salary excluding overtime (CST art. 192).

Source: per-employee monthly amount = WT 79401 'Annual leave payout'. The per-episode 'Amount' of the leave register is NOT used: it is a per-employee value repeated on every row and does not add up across episodes. Where an employee has several vacation episodes in the month, the Pago of each element is the monthly amount split by days (supplied by the engine). Do NOT include WT 62150 'Vacation Bonus' (extralegal premium) - it is a bonus, not vacation pay.
